body.command: CHECKPOINT_SKIP="apt install of TeX for BASELINES.pdf render, not an experiment" bash -c 'apt-get install -y -q texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended lmodern > /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-cryptanalysis/36af9c24-250d-50f8-a15e-3317682d041c/scratchpad/apt.log 2>&1 || (apt-get update -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -q texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended lmodern >> /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-cryptanalysis/36af9c24-250d-50f8-a15e-3317682d041c/scratchpad/apt.log 2>&1)'; echo done $?; tail -3 /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-cryptanalysis/36af9c24-250d-50f8-a15e-3317682d041c/scratchpad/apt.log

cp BASELINES.pdf /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-cryptanalysis/36af9c24-250d-50f8-a15e-3317682d041c/scratchpad/BASELINES.old.pdf && CHECKPOINT_SKIP="pandoc render of BASELINES.pdf, not an experiment" timeout 900 pandoc BASELINES.md -o BASELINES.pdf --pdf-engine=pdflatex -H pdf-header.tex --lua-filter=wrap-code.lua -V geometry:landscape,margin=1.2cm -V fontsize=9pt 2>&1 | tail -15; ls -la BASELINES.pdf; pandoc --version | head -1; pdflatex --version | head -1
